source.title: Federalni plan upravljanja otpadom 2012-2017
source.why_relevant: Official FBiH Federal Ministry of Environment and Tourism waste plan setting targets for separate collection of garden/park bio-waste and for using biodegradable waste to make compost and biofuels.
source.quote: Operativni cilj 2.3: Odvojeno prikupiti bio-otpad iz vrtova i parkova; Operativni cilj 2.8: Biorazgradljivi otpad iskorišten za proizvodnju komposta i biogoriva (Federalni plan upravljanja otpadom 2012-2017, Federalno ministarstvo okoliša i turizma FBiH, Sarajevo, decembar 2011).
source.quote_en: EN (my translation): Operational objective 2.3: 'Separately collect bio-waste from gardens and parks'; Operational objective 2.8: 'Biodegradable waste used for production of compost and biofuels'.

verify.how_verified: Opened the URL with web_extract (full-text PDF extraction); the cover, title, date (Sarajevo, decembar 2011), and ministry (Federalno ministarstvo okoliša i turizma) matched the recorded citation. Located both operative goals in the saved full text of that URL and compared them word-for-word with the recorded quote.
verify.limitations: PDF text extraction may carry minor artifacts: each item carries a leading bullet (•) on the page, and "2.8:" has no following space ("2.8:Biorazgradljivi"); I treated those as non-substantive. Could not confirm the printed page number of the list (TOC cites Tabela 14 on page 39). No DOI exists for this document.
